title: Shikha and Sonu with two tapes
description: Two friends at a weaving table with a folded sari, one with a tape marked in centimetres and one with a tape marked in metres.

title: A pencil in cm and a wall in m
description: A pencil of 17 cm beside a ruler and a classroom wall of 8 m beside a tape, with the fitting unit chip and the other chip crossed out.

title: 3 m is 300 cm on a double number line
description: A double number line with m on the top line, cm on the bottom line and the arrow ×100, showing 3 m = 300 cm and 450 cm = 4 m 50 cm.

title: 7 m 9 cm and 790 cm as bars on one tape
description: Two bars on one tape in cm: 7 m 9 cm which is 709 cm, and 790 cm, with 7 m 9 cm < 790 cm.

title: How much longer is 285 cm than 2 m 60 cm
description: Two bars on one tape, 285 cm and 2 m 60 cm which is 260 cm, with the gap of 25 cm marked.

title: 1 km is 1,000 m on a road
description: A road strip marked 0 km to 7 km with 1 km = 1,000 m on the first km and 7 km = 7,000 m on the whole road.

title: Five flags on a 2 km track
description: A 2 km track with a flag after every 400 m, five flags with their positions, and 2,000 ÷ 400 = 5 flags.

title: Stations on a route
description: A route line with the first station at 0 km, Station Q at 340 km and Station R at 615 km, and 615 − 340 = 275 km between Q and R.

title: One centimetre cut into ten parts
description: A lens on 1 cm of a ruler and the magnified centimetre with its ten equal parts of 1 mm, written 1 cm = 10 mm.

title: A line of 4 cm 6 mm on a ruler
description: A ruler from 0 to 6 cm with a line that ends on the 6th small mark after 4 cm, written 4 cm 6 mm = 46 mm.

title: Three double number lines
description: Three double number lines: cm over mm with ×10, m over cm with ×100 and km over m with ×1,000, each with its example tick.

title: 73 m 5 cm split into two parts
description: A bar of 7,305 cm split into 7,300 cm which is 73 m and 5 cm, written 7,305 cm = 73 m 5 cm.

title: 2 km 700 m plus 1 km 800 m in two columns
description: A km column and a m column with 2 km 700 m plus 1 km 800 m, a carried 1 km and the total 4 km 500 m.

title: A ribbon of 9 m with 3 m 40 cm cut off
description: A ribbon of 9 m with a cut piece of 3 m 40 cm and the piece left, 5 m 60 cm, on a tape in cm.

title: Twelve curtain strips and their two piles
description: Twelve curtain strips of 2 m 40 cm with the metres and the centimetres sorted into two piles and the total 28 m 80 cm.

title: A road shared into three equal days
labels: 18 km divided by 3 is 6 km, 900 m divided by 3 is 300 m
description: A road of 18 km 900 m shared into 3 equal days, each day 6 km 300 m.

title: Ribbon prices on a double number line
description: A double number line with 3 m, 6 m and 9 m over ₹90, ₹180 and ₹270, the arrow ×3 and 90 ÷ 3 = ₹30 for 1 m.

title: A wall as high as two doors
description: A wall as high as two doors of about 2 m each, so about 4 m high.

title: A wall chart at 4 feet 6 inches
description: A wall chart with foot marks and a child whose head is at 4 feet 6 inches, written 4 × 12 + 6 = 54 inches.

title: A 3 by 3 sign grid
labels: each row and column has +, − and × once
description: A 3 by 3 grid with + in the top left box, × in the middle box and − in the bottom right box, six boxes empty.

title: The chapter on one wall tape
description: A wall tape with eight cards, each with one idea of the chapter and its key fact.
